finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panels on the provisioned dashboard `Service health` (folder "Bench", URL `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`), exactly as shown, in order:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**2. DONE** — New dashboard `fwgr55-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr55-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (query row A = TestData, Scenario "Random Walk"). Verified after save: panel visible on the dashboard (rendering a stat value, e.g. 60.2 / 71.0).

**3. DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr55-n1 Notes` with Markdown content `# fwgr55-n1 Notes\n\nNotes for run fwgr55-n1`; the rendered panel body reads "Notes for run fwgr55-n1", which includes the runid. Saved ("Dashboard saved" alert observed).

**4. DONE** — Tag `bench` added and time range set to **Last 6 hours**, saved with the save dialog's "Update default time range" box ticked. Verified after a fresh page load: a param-less load of the dashboard was rewritten by Grafana to `?from=now-6h&to=now`, and the JSON Model shows `tags: ["bench"]` and `time: {from: "now-6h", to: "now"}`. (Note: the tag chip is visible in Dashboard settings → General → Tags and in the search results, not on the dashboard view page itself.)

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **1m**, saved with the save dialog's "Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default" box ticked. Verified after a fresh page load: the top-bar refresh picker reads `1m` (accessible name: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), the URL was rewritten to include `&refresh=1m`, and the JSON Model shows `refresh: "1m"`.

**6. DONE** — Dashboard URL read from the browser's page URL (window.location.href) after a fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffyjmel139pfke/fwgr55-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
UID: `ffyjmel139pfke`. Page title confirmed as `fwgr55-n1 Bench Dashboard - Dashboards - Grafana`, with panels `fwgr55-n1 Notes` and `fwgr55-n1 Availability` visible.
